  Online
Join us for the AI Builders Conference with IBM Bob, a virtual event taking place on September 16, 2026, from 10:00 AM–1:30 PM ET. Designed for students, educators, developers, and innovators, the conference brings together IBM experts, industry leaders, and the global AI builder community to explore the future of AI-assisted software development, agentic AI, and AI-powered learning.The conference will begin with a keynote session for all attendees before splitting into two dedicated learning tracks:Student Track: Explore how AI is transforming software development by shifting the focus from writing code to designing intelligent systems.
